qs.name: ProgName
qs.q: What do you call this separation programme?
qs.help: Shown in every report and form header.

qs.name: BuyerName
qs.q: What is the buyer's name for this transaction?
qs.help: Legal or trading name used in reports. Also suggested as an entity on the Lists sheet.

qs.name: SellerName
qs.q: What is the seller's name for this transaction?
qs.help: Legal or trading name used in reports. Also suggested as an entity on the Lists sheet.

qs.name: Perspective
qs.q: Which side are you on: buyer or seller?
qs.help: Drives "our" and "their" throughout the Hub: suggested owners, cost shares and which invoices you issue.

qs.name: HubOwner
qs.q: Who runs this Hub (usually the SMO lead)?
qs.help: Suggested automatically once the People sheet has someone with the role SMO lead. Used as interviewer, approver and engagement owner.

qs.name: SignDate
qs.q: What is the signing date of the main deal agreements?
qs.help: On or before the closing date.

qs.name: CloseDate
qs.q: What is the closing date (Day 1)?
qs.help: Drives every calculated date in the Hub; fees cannot be forecast without it.

qs.name: RepCcy
qs.q: Which currency should reports use?
qs.help: All money in reports is shown in this currency. Add every other currency, with its rate, on the Lists sheet.

qs.name: FYStart
qs.q: In which month does your financial year start? (1 = January)
qs.help: Used by the cost reports only; TSA fees always use calendar years.

qs.name: FeeCap
qs.q: Is there a cap on total TSA fees? If so, how much? (leave blank if none)
qs.help: In the reporting currency.

qs.name: ConsentSplit
qs.q: What share of third-party consent costs does the buyer pay?
qs.help: The seller pays the rest.

qs.name: ConsentCap
qs.q: Is there a cap on what your side pays for consents? (leave blank if none)
qs.help: The most this Hub's side pays towards third-party consent costs, in the reporting currency; checked on Third Parties, with a warning at 80%.

qs.name: LongStop
qs.q: What is the TSA's long-stop date (the latest any service may run, extensions included)?

qs.name: DefTerm
qs.q: What is the usual initial term of a service, in months?
qs.help: Copied to each service; change it per service where the schedules differ.

qs.name: ExitConv
qs.q: On which day do services end?
qs.help: First of month: a service exits on the 1st and the last month charged is the month before.

qs.name: DefExitNotice
qs.q: How many days' notice are needed to end a service on its planned date?

qs.name: DefEENotice
qs.q: How many days' notice are needed to end a service early?

qs.name: DefExtNotice
qs.q: How many days' notice are needed to extend a service?

qs.name: DefPartial
qs.q: Can part of a service be ended on its own (partial exit)? (Y or N)

qs.name: EEResp
qs.q: How many business days does the provider have to respond to an early exit request?

qs.name: EEDecide
qs.q: How many business days does the recipient then have to decide?

qs.name: ExtCount
qs.q: How many extensions does the TSA allow?
qs.help: Up to four. Each can carry its own fee mark-up below.

qs.name: ExtMaxMonths
qs.q: What is the longest each extension can be, in months?
qs.help: Also the suggested length of each extension below.

qs.name: ExtMonths1
qs.q: How many months does extension 1 run for?
qs.help: Usually the maximum months per extension.

qs.name: ExtPct1
qs.q: What fee mark-up applies during extension 1?
qs.help: Enter 0% if the TSA has no uplift.

qs.name: ExtMonths2
qs.q: How many months does extension 2 run for?
qs.help: Usually the maximum months per extension.

qs.name: ExtPct2
qs.q: What fee mark-up applies during extension 2?
qs.help: Enter 0% if the TSA has no uplift.

qs.name: ExtMonths3
qs.q: How many months does extension 3 run for?
qs.help: Usually the maximum months per extension.

qs.name: ExtPct3
qs.q: What fee mark-up applies during extension 3?
qs.help: Enter 0% if the TSA has no uplift.

qs.name: ExtMonths4
qs.q: How many months does extension 4 run for?
qs.help: Usually the maximum months per extension.

qs.name: ExtPct4
qs.q: What fee mark-up applies during extension 4?
qs.help: Enter 0% if the TSA has no uplift.

qs.name: InvFreq
qs.q: How often are TSA fees invoiced?

qs.name: PayTerms
qs.q: How many days are allowed to pay an invoice?
qs.help: Counted from receipt.

qs.name: DisputeDays
qs.q: How many days are allowed to dispute an invoice?
qs.help: Counted from receipt.

qs.name: OOPThr
qs.q: Above what amount do out-of-pocket expenses need approval? (leave blank if none)
qs.help: In the reporting currency.

qs.name: VarThr
qs.q: How far can an invoice differ from the expected fees before it is flagged?
qs.help: A tolerance you choose, not a contract term.

qs.name: OmitDays
qs.q: How many days after closing can omitted services still be added?

qs.name: RevPt1
qs.q: How many days before exit is the first readiness interview?
qs.help: Readiness interviews: before each service ends, the SMO lead meets the workstream lead to check nine areas are ready. Leave all four blank if this programme does not hold them: nothing is then scheduled or flagged.

qs.name: RevPt2
qs.q: And the second?

qs.name: RevPt3
qs.q: And the third?

qs.name: RevPt4
qs.q: And the fourth?

qs.name: Shortfall
qs.q: After how many months in a row below standard does the recipient get a remedy?
